description: This file defines an Android activity that demonstrates how to show the input method subtype enabler. It creates a user interface with buttons to trigger the input method settings activity, either for all input methods or specific ones with multiple subtypes.

classes.name: ShowInputMethodAndSubtypeEnabler
classes.description: An activity that displays buttons to open the input method subtype settings for all input methods or specific ones with multiple subtypes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity UI by creating layout and buttons for input method settings.

methods.name: showInputMethodAndSubtypeEnabler
methods.description: Static method that launches the input method subtype settings activity, optionally targeting a specific input method ID.

methods.name: getEnabledInputMethodsThatHaveMultipleSubtypes
methods.description: Retrieves a list of enabled input methods that have more than one subtype.
